description: Each fact about one token as of a day (the last review) against now: owner powers and owner, on-chain and circulating supply, top-10 wallet share, DEX liquidity, 2% sell depth, dangerous copies, chains, unlocks ahead and price, whether each changed past its bar, and the signals in between. Daily history for the top 1000 over 180 days; outside it only price. Use when someone asks what changed with a token, since when, or before re-checking a holding.

lang.description: Language of the text answer: en or ru

since.description: A UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD: the day of the last review. Default: 7 days ago

token.description: Token name, ticker or id, e.g. "UNI"

name: token_changes

anyOf.description: What changed about a token between a day and now.

items.description: One fact on the day asked and now.

added.description: Lists: what is new since then; null for other facts

change.description: Numbers: relative change (0.25 = +25%); for top10_wallets and dangerous_copies the difference itself. Null otherwise

fact.description: Which fact. price: price in US dollars, CoinGecko, daily; a change is 10% or more; owner_powers: powers the contract’s owner holds (GoPlus flags: mint, blacklist, pause, take balances…); any power gained or lost is a change; owner: the owner address of the home contract, or "renounced"; a new owner is a change; supply_onchain: total supply of the home contract read from the chain, burn addresses aside; 0.5% or more; circulating: circulating supply as CoinGecko states it; 1% or more; top10_wallets: share of supply in the ten largest plain wallets (no contracts, locks, burn or exchange addresses), 0..1; 2 points or more; dex_liquidity: liquidity in DEX pools quoted in a trusted asset, US dollars; 20% or more; depth_2pct: sell depth within 2% on centralised venues, US dollars; 20% or more; dangerous_copies: tokens trading under its ticker whose owner can take balances or trap sellers; any difference; chains: its official contract addresses as CoinGecko lists them, the home one included; any added or removed; unlocks_30d: tokens unlocking in the 30 days after that day; 10% or more

anyOf.description: A fact’s value and the day it was read.

day.description: The UTC day this value was read (YYYY-MM-DD): the last read on or before the day asked

value.description: A number, a text, or a list, as the fact says

now.description: As of the latest read; null when not read

removed.description: Lists: what is gone since then; null for other facts

status.description: How it moved. changed: differs past the fact’s bar; unchanged: within the bar; appeared: not read on that day, read now; gone: read on that day, not read now; unread: read on neither

anyOf.description: A fact’s value and the day it was read.

day.description: The UTC day this value was read (YYYY-MM-DD): the last read on or before the day asked

value.description: A number, a text, or a list, as the fact says

was.description: As of the day asked; null when not read by then

historyFrom.description: The first day the fact history reaches; facts before it read as not read. Null outside the top 1000, where only price is kept

readAt.description: When the latest values were published

signals.description: Signals about the token after the day asked, oldest first

items.description: A signal about the token, by kind and key.

at.description: When the change behind it was read

key.description: The signal’s key, as /signals lists it

kind.description: Signal kind. unlock: see /signals?kind=unlock; mint: see /signals?kind=mint; bridge: see /signals?kind=bridge; admin: see /signals?kind=admin; whale: see /signals?kind=whale; drain: see /signals?kind=drain; fake: see /signals?kind=fake; hack: see /signals?kind=hack; listing: see /signals?kind=listing; site: see /signals?kind=site

title: What changed since a day
